title: Finite affine charts subordinate to fppf local lifts
statement: Let $a:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose there is a set-indexed fppf covering $\{q_i:Y_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] and maps $s_i:Y_i\to X$ satisfying $a\circ s_i=q_i$. For every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq Y$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], there are an integer $n\geq0$, affine opens $U_j=\operatorname{Spec}A_j\subseteq X$ with $a(U_j)\subseteq V$, and affine schemes $T_j=\operatorname{Spec}D_j$, with maps $t_j:T_j\to U_j$ and $r_j:T_j\to V$ for $1\leq j\leq n$, such that $r_j=(a|_{U_j})\circ t_j$ and $\{r_j:T_j\to V\}$ is an fppf covering. Thus the induced maps on rings are $B\to A_j\to D_j$. Each $B\to D_j$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and the coordinate map $B\to D:=\prod_{j=1}^nD_j$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and of finite presentation. No property is assumed of $a$ itself. Empty $V$ is allowed, with $n=0$ and $B=D=0$.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, first proof paragraph through the faithfully flat finitely presented product map; Topologies Tag 021P, lemma-fppf-affine, supplies the finite affine refinement.

proof.text: For nonempty $V$, form $P_i=V\times_Y Y_i$ with projections $p_i:P_i\to Y_i$ and $g_i:P_i\to V$. Base change of the given covering makes $\{g_i\}$ fppf. Set $\sigma_i=s_i p_i:P_i\to X$. The fibre-product equality and $a s_i=q_i$ give $a\sigma_i=\iota_V g_i$, so $\sigma_i(P_i)\subseteq a^{-1}(V)$. For empty $V$ take $n=0$; the chart clauses are vacuous and step 5 verifies the ring conclusion.

Use the affine-opens basis to cover the open $a^{-1}(V)\subseteq X$ by affine opens $U_k$. For each $i$, the opens $W_{ik}=\sigma_i^{-1}(U_k)$ cover $P_i$: a point maps into $a^{-1}(V)$ and hence into some $U_k$. Thus $\{W_{ik}\to P_i\}_k$ is a Zariski covering and consequently an fppf covering. Apply the composition clause of the covering calculus, using its equivalence for scheme families, to obtain the fppf covering $\{W_{ik}\to P_i\xrightarrow{g_i}V\}_{i,k}$. These are set-indexed families since the opens of a scheme form a set.

source.place: Tags 021O (lemma-fppf, (2)) and 021N (Zariski coverings are fppf); descent Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, first paragraph

proof.text: Apply finite affine fppf refinement to the covering of step 2 over the affine scheme $V$. It gives finitely many affine opens $T_j=\operatorname{Spec}D_j\subseteq W_{i(j),k(j)}$ whose composite maps $r_j:T_j\to V$ are an fppf covering. Put $U_j=U_{k(j)}=\operatorname{Spec}A_j$. The image of $T_j\to P_{i(j)}\xrightarrow{\sigma_{i(j)}}X$ lies in $U_j$ by the definition of $W_{i(j),k(j)}$, so the open-subscheme factorization lemma gives $t_j:T_j\to U_j$. The same lemma gives $a|_{U_j}:U_j\to V$. Composing with the open inclusion $V\to Y$ gives equal maps, hence $r_j=(a|_{U_j})t_j$ by uniqueness of that factorization.

source.place: Tag 021P, lemma-fppf-affine; descent Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, affine preparation

proof.text: The contravariant functoriality of the affine spectrum turns $r_j=(a|_{U_j})t_j$ into the ring factorization $B\to A_j\to D_j$. Each $r_j$ is flat and locally of finite presentation by the definition of fppf covering. Apply the affine flatness criterion and the affine-open finite-presentation criterion with the whole source $T_j$ and target $V$ to obtain flatness and finite presentation of $B\to D_j$. A finite presentation also supplies a surjection from a polynomial ring on finitely many variables, so each $D_j$ is of finite type over $B$ by the definitions.

source.place: Tag 06NB, lemma-curiosity, product-map preparation; Morphisms Tags 01U5 and 01TQ; Algebra Tag 00F3

proof.text: Apply the finite-affine-family algebra lemma with its rings $R=A=B$ and identity $R\to A$, and its factors $B_j=D_j$. Step 4 supplies flatness, finite presentation and finite type of every factor; step 3 supplies joint surjectivity of their spectra. Its coordinate-map conclusion is precisely that $B\to D=\prod_jD_j$ is faithfully flat and of finite presentation. When $V$ is empty, use the empty family: joint surjectivity holds, the factor hypotheses are vacuous, and the same lemma explicitly gives $B=0$ and the empty product $D=0$, together with the stated ring properties.
